title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - OperationModeElement
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/OperationModeElement. Operation Mode Elements of a Fill Rate Based Control Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'OperationModeElement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

fillRate.description: Relationship. Indicates the change in fill_level per second. The lower_boundary of the NumberRange is associated with an operation_mode_factor of 0, the upper_boundary is associated with an operation_mode_factor of 1. Relationship to NumberRange.

hasFillLevelRange.description: Relationship. The range of the fill level for which this FRBC.OperationModeElement applies. If this concept is applied on a Storage it indicated the range in which a storage should remain. Relationship to NumberRange.

hasPowerRange.description: Relationship. The power produced or consumed by this operation mode. The start of each PowerRange is associated with an operation_mode_factor of 0, the end is associated with an operation_mode_factor of 1. In the array there must be at least one PowerRange, and at most one PowerRange per Commodity. Relationship to PowerRange.

hasRunningCosts.description: Relationship. Additional costs per second (e.g. wear, services) associated with this operation mode in the currency defined by the ResourceManagerDetails , excluding the commodity cost. The range is expressing uncertainty and is not linked to the operation_mode_factor. Relationship to NumberRange.
